info.long_name: Age at time of ED visit
info.short_description: Age band of the patient at the time of the emergency department visit.
info.long_description: Age at the time of the visit, in bands: 0-9, 10-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-44, 45-64 and 65+. '0-24' is the exported under-25 band; it overlaps the bands below it and is not a seventh band. 'Overall' is the unstratified row covering all ages. The bands (and 0-24) do not add up to 'Overall' in the visit counts or in the age shares. Median and quartile length-of-stay columns are populated on 'Overall' and on state and national age-band rows (including 0-24); the age share (epic_ed_pct_age_*) is populated on state and national age-band rows; the diagnosis share (epic_ed_pct_visits_*) is national 'Overall' only. The all-cause visit count (epic_ed_n_visits) is populated on every age band, on 0-24 and on 'Overall', nationally and by state.

info.short_name: Median ED length of stay: Suicidal behavior
info.long_name: Median emergency department length of stay for Suicidal behavior encounters
info.short_description: Median time in minutes from ED arrival to ED departure for Suicidal behavior encounters.
info.long_description: Median emergency department length of stay in minutes for Suicidal behavior. Encounters are Epic Cosmos ED encounters with a United States country of residence, attributed to the patient's state of residence and to the calendar quarter of arrival, and assigned to the Suicidal behavior bucket of the ED Diagnoses grouper. Length of stay runs from arrival to ED departure, so it includes boarding time for patients awaiting an inpatient or psychiatric bed. This is the most robust of the length-of-stay statistics in this source: unlike the mean, standard deviation, minimum and maximum, it is not distorted by the small number of encounters with corrupted arrival or departure timestamps, and it is the recommended default for trend and cross-state comparison. It is published for the 'Overall' age row and for each five-year age band at the state level (see the age variable). It runs well below the mean for every mental health bucket, which is the signature of a long right tail of boarded patients. Cells built on 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source and left missing; a missing value and a suppression flag of 1 mean the same thing, because every value the source published is carried through as published. A flag that is itself missing means the exports do not report this statistic for that row (outside the quarters it covers, or not a stratum the column describes). Note that the 'All ED encounters' variant is the total row of the ED Diagnoses grouper: it covers every ED encounter, including the non-mental-health diagnoses not displayed as their own columns, and is not a total of the mental health buckets.
info.statement: In {location}, the median Suicidal behavior ED encounter lasted {value} minutes.

info.short_name: Suppressed flag: median ED length of stay, Suicidal behavior
info.long_name: Suppression flag for the Suicidal behavior median ED length of stay
info.short_description: Indicates whether the Suicidal behavior median ED length of stay was suppressed at source.
info.long_description: This flag is 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the Suicidal behavior median ED length of stay because the cell was built on 10 or fewer encounters, and 0 otherwise. These statistics are not counts, so a suppressed value cannot be imputed - there is no published denominator to impute a numerator against - and epic_ed_los_median_suicidal_behavior is left missing wherever this flag is 1. Within the quarters the export covers, a flag of 1 and a missing value coincide exactly. Epic omits suppressed rows from these exports entirely, so a flag of 1 can also mean the row was not returned. The flag is missing where the exports do not report the median for the row at all (outside the quarters it covers). Check it before comparing across geographies: suppression is heavy in the sparser diagnosis buckets.

info.long_name: Number of emergency department visits, all encounters
info.short_description: Number of Epic Cosmos ED encounters, for any diagnosis, in the geography, quarter and age band.
info.long_description: Number of Epic Cosmos emergency department encounters with a United States country of residence, for any diagnosis, attributed to the patient's state of residence and the calendar quarter of arrival. It is the Number of ED Encounters from the Epic Cosmos state-by-age-by-month crosstab, as exported; the only step applied is summing the three months of each quarter. 'Overall' is the all-ages total Epic reports for the geography. The age bands are the age rows Epic reports; they do not add up to 'Overall' (they cover roughly 81% of a state's all-ages visits), and the cause of the difference is not known. A 'No value' age row in the export is disregarded. The 0-24 row is the exported 'Less than 25 Years' row; it overlaps the bands below it. A 'Less than 5 Years' row in the export is not published. Cells of 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source and imputed as 5. It covers all ED encounters, not only the mental health diagnoses,. It is published only for quarters covered by the length-of-stay export (2022-Q3 onward); earlier months of the crosstab are not used.

info.long_name: Suppression flag for the ED visit count
info.short_description: Indicates whether the ED visit count includes a month that was suppressed and imputed as 5 at source.
info.long_description: This flag is 1 when at least one of the three months summed into the quarter was built on 10 or fewer encounters, so Epic Cosmos suppressed it and it was imputed as 5, and 0 otherwise. Unlike the length-of-stay flags the value is kept, not left missing, because a count can be imputed.

Encounters are Epic Cosmos ED encounters with a United States country of residence, attributed to the patient's state of residence and to the calendar quarter of arrival, and assigned to the Other mental health bucket of the ED Diagnoses grouper. Length of stay runs from arrival to ED departure, so it includes boarding time for patients awaiting an inpatient or psychiatric bed. Read with epic_ed_los_median_other and epic_ed_los_q3_other it describes the spread of stays, and the Q3 - Q1 gap is a measure of boarding that, like the median, is not distorted by the small number of encounters with corrupted timestamps. Published for the 'Overall' age row and for each five-year age band at the state level (see the age variable); the national row is Overall age only. Suppression is heavier in small states and in the Other bucket. Cells built on 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source and left missing; a flag of 1 means suppressed or not returned, and a flag that is itself missing means the export did not report this statistic for that row.
epic_ed_los_q1_other.statement: In {location}, one quarter of Other mental health ED encounters lasted under {value} minutes.

It is missing when the age-sliced export does not report this statistic for the row (for example outside the quarters the export coverss, or for a row that is not a stratum the column describes). These statistics are not counts, so a suppressed value cannot be imputed and epic_ed_los_q1_suicidal_behavior is left missing wherever this flag is 1. Because Epic omits suppressed rows from the age-sliced exports entirely, a flag of 1 can also mean the row was not returned.

epic_ed_pct_age_suicidal_behavior.short_name: Age share of Suicidal behavior ED encounters
epic_ed_pct_age_suicidal_behavior.long_name: Percentage of a geography's (state or national) Suicidal behavior emergency department encounters that were in the age band
epic_ed_pct_age_suicidal_behavior.short_description: Percent of the geography's (state or national) Suicidal behavior ED encounters in the quarter that fell in the age band.
epic_ed_pct_age_suicidal_behavior.long_description: Age distribution of Suicidal behavior emergency department encounters: of all of a state's ED encounters in the quarter with a Suicidal behavior diagnosis, the percent that were in the row's age band. The source field is 'Percentage of Sliced Population' for the age slice, whose denominator is the state's Suicidal behavior encounters at every age. The seven non-overlapping bands (0-9, 10-14, 15-19, 20-24, 25-44, 45-64, 65+) sum to roughly 87-90% rather than 100%, in addition to any band suppressed or not returned; the cause of the shortfall is not known. It is a share of the diagnosis, not a share of all ED encounters, so it describes who the Suicidal behavior patients are rather than how common the diagnosis is in each age group. Published for age-band rows at the state level only; it is missing on the 'Overall' age row and nationally. Percentages carry three significant digits at source, so small shares are rounded coarsely. Missing where the cell was suppressed at source.
epic_ed_pct_age_suicidal_behavior.statement: In {location}, {value}% of Suicidal behavior ED encounters were in this age group.

epic_ed_n_visits.long_name: Number of emergency department visits, all encounters
epic_ed_n_visits.short_description: Number of Epic Cosmos ED encounters, for any diagnosis, in the geography, quarter and age band.
epic_ed_n_visits.long_description: Number of Epic Cosmos emergency department encounters with a United States country of residence, for any diagnosis, attributed to the patient's state of residence and the calendar quarter of arrival. It is the Number of ED Encounters from the Epic Cosmos state-by-age-by-month crosstab, as exported; the only step applied is summing the three months of each quarter. 'Overall' is the all-ages total Epic reports for the geography. The age bands are the age rows Epic reports; they do not add up to 'Overall' (they cover roughly 81% of a state's all-ages visits), and the cause of the difference is not known. A 'No value' age row in the export is disregarded. The 0-24 row is the exported 'Less than 25 Years' row; it overlaps the bands below it. A 'Less than 5 Years' row in the export is not published. Cells of 10 or fewer encounters are suppressed at source and imputed as 5. It covers all ED encounters, not only the mental health diagnoses,. It is published only for quarters covered by the length-of-stay export (2022-Q3 onward); earlier months of the crosstab are not used.

epic_ed_n_visits_suppressed_flag.long_name: Suppression flag for the ED visit count
epic_ed_n_visits_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the ED visit count includes a month that was suppressed and imputed as 5 at source.
epic_ed_n_visits_suppressed_flag.long_description: This flag is 1 when at least one of the three months summed into the quarter was built on 10 or fewer encounters, so Epic Cosmos suppressed it and it was imputed as 5, and 0 otherwise. Unlike the length-of-stay flags the value is kept, not left missing, because a count can be imputed.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. Note that county-level and city-level stratifications could differ markedly in total sample size due to high levels of missingness of county data in some states.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
